name: gw2_rafah1983
title: File:Aerial view of Rafah Border Crossing from an MFO helicopter, 1983.jpg
author: Evdpnl
description: Aerial photograph of the international Rafah Border Crossing between Egypt and the Israeli-controlled Gaza Strip, captured in 1983 from an MFO (Multinational Force and Observers) helicopter. The image provides a bird's-eye view of the border infrastructure and surrounding agricultural fields shortly after the final Israeli withdrawal from the Sinai Peninsula under the Camp David Accords.
